main.title: Two humans’ worth of output, one human.

main.label: The short version
main.heading: We build things and post about them.
main.text: drei.gg is a one-person studio with ==two AI agents and a workstation== doing the heavy lifting. No funnel, no launch week. Things get built, then they get a post.

main.markdown:
## Why .gg

It's a gamer thing, it's my name, and in PH lobbies it's what you type when the other team has already lost. Building software in the year of the AI doompost feels a lot like that: good luck, we're all screwed, build anyway.
